clips.title: The story
paras: In Ashenvale, Horde hunters face the ancient forest's three great predators. Senani Thunderheart oversees the trial at Splintertree Post, where hunters track Ursangous, Shadumbra, and Sharptalon to prove their skill.

Senani Thunderheart gives the Horde's presence in Ashenvale a different kind of test. While Orcs gather lumber, she sends hunters into the shadowed forest to face its strongest predators. The hunt calls for more than strength: hunters must meet the wilderness with cunning and respect, and learn what they can endure.

Three solitary beasts test those who take up the hunt. Ursangous, an immense elder bear, roams near the Talondeep Path. Shadumbra, a cunning nightsaber, stalks the eastern borders near Raynewood Retreat and the Laughing Sisters. South of Splintertree Post, Sharptalon, a fierce hippogryph, wheels above the forest canopy.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There are three legendary creatures that make up the Ashenvale Hunt; you may seek them and test yourself against their cunning and might. In the process, you will hopefully learn something about yourself. The creatures are: the bear Ursangous, the nightsaber cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon.
The creatures of the Ashenvale Hunt are powerful, and you may find that you'll need aid in bringing them down. If you should best them, bring me proof of your deed.
